announcements.title: Water tank cleaning schedule
announcements.summary: A short water-supply interruption is planned for Kanhar and Gopad on 5 November.
announcements.description: Routine water tank cleaning is planned for Kanhar and Gopad on Thursday, 5 November 2026. Water supply to these hostels will be temporarily interrupted while the cleaning is carried out.
announcements.extraMessage: Please store enough drinking water in advance and keep taps closed during the interruption. Supply is expected to resume once cleaning and the routine checks are complete.
announcements.closing:
If you notice a supply issue after the scheduled window, please raise an issue through the portal and include your hostel and room number.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
Hostel services team

announcements.title: Common room feedback session
announcements.summary: Share your suggestions for our common rooms at the upcoming student feedback session.
announcements.description: A student feedback session will be held to collect suggestions about the common rooms. Residents are welcome to share ideas about facilities, timings and activities.
announcements.extraMessage: Please share your suggestions respectfully so that the hostel team can review them.
announcements.closing: Thank you for participating.\nStudent affairs team

announcements.title: Bicycle parking reminder
announcements.summary: Please use the marked bicycle stands and keep hostel entrances and walkways clear.
announcements.description: Residents are requested to park bicycles only in the marked bicycle stands. Please do not block hostel entrances, ramps or walkways.
announcements.extraMessage: This will help keep the entrances clear and make movement around the hostel safer for everyone.
announcements.closing: Thank you for your cooperation.\nHostel administration
